summary.headline: Vatican Codices 9–10
summary.text: Descriptions of Vatican codices 1038 and 1057, including Euclid, Hypsicles, Heron, Ptolemy’s works and Tetrabiblos, and extensive astrological books attributed to Apomasar and Palch, with chapter tables, folio references, scribal notes, and comparisons to Florentine and Angelican codices.
